blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.prompt: Tom started a fight with Mary.
exercises.why: **затеять → затеял** — past tense, masc.: drop -ть, add -л.

exercises.prompt: He took this photo.
exercises.why: **сделать → сделал** — past tense, masc.: drop -ть, add -л.

exercises.prompt: Tom and Mary sang in unison.
exercises.why: **петь → пели** — past tense, plural: drop -ть, add -ли.

exercises.prompt: Tom got very good at it.
exercises.why: **поднатореть → поднаторел** — past tense, masc.: drop -ть, add -л.

exercises.prompt: I fell and hit my tailbone.
exercises.why: **упасть → упал** — past tense, masc. (irregular stem).

exercises.prompt: He didn't hide his satisfaction.
exercises.why: **скрывать → скрывал** — past tense, masc.: drop -ть, add -л.

exercises.prompt: I didn’t take you for such a selfless person.
exercises.why: **считать → считал** — past tense, masc.: drop -ть, add -л.

exercises.prompt: He emptied his glass.
exercises.why: **опустошить → опустошил** — past tense, masc.: drop -ть, add -л.

exercises.prompt: Tom ended up behind bars.
exercises.why: **очутиться → очутился** — past tense, masc.: drop -ться, add -лся.

exercises.prompt: I went to Kawagoe by taxi.
exercises.why: **поехать → поехал** — past tense, masc.: drop -ть, add -л.

exercises.prompt: Santa Claus was standing in the garden.
exercises.why: **стоять → стоял** — past tense, masc.: drop -ть, add -л.

exercises.prompt: Her help came at just the right moment.
exercises.why: **подоспеть → подоспела** — past tense, fem.: drop -ть, add -ла.

exercises.prompt: The gang was planning a robbery.
exercises.why: **планировать → планировала** — past tense, fem.: drop -ть, add -ла.

exercises.prompt: Tom got involved in a fight at the bar.
exercises.why: **ввязаться → ввязался** — past tense, masc.: drop -ться, add -лся.

exercises.prompt: He stamped out the fire.
exercises.why: **затоптать → затоптал** — past tense, masc.: drop -ть, add -л.

exercises.prompt: Tom changed the subject abruptly.
exercises.why: **сменить → сменил** — past tense, masc.: drop -ть, add -л.

exercises.prompt: The situation hasn't improved.
exercises.why: **улучшиться → улучшилась** — past tense, fem.: drop -ться, add -лась.

exercises.q: Томас говорит, что никогда не ___ (есть) артишок.
exercises.prompt: Tom says that he has never eaten an artichoke.
exercises.why: **есть → ел** — past tense, masc. (irregular stem).

exercises.prompt: Have you tried this cake? It's to die for.
exercises.why: **пробовать → Пробовал** — past tense, masc.: drop -ть, add -л.

exercises.prompt: A dog is following us.
exercises.why: **увязаться → увязался** — past tense, masc.: drop -ться, add -лся.
